paper_metadata.title: Hardness and strength enhancements of CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloy with Nd doping

evidence.quote: CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloy with FCC structure has been proven to be an ultra-ductile but low-strength alloy.

parameters.deformation: ~80% total thickness reduction, ten passes of ~8% each; from ~16.7 to ~3.3 mm

evidence.quote: The ingots were subsequently cold rolled in the same direction ten times with the thickness reduction of ~8% for each rolling to prevent cracking. In the present case, the starting and the final thicknesses of ingots were ~16.7 and ~3.3 mm, respectively, with the total thickness reduction of ~80%.
The cold-rolled sheets were then annealed at 900 ºC for 1 h in the Ar atmosphere and quenched in water to obtain fully recrystallized microstructure with reduced grain sizes for strength enhancement.
